2 failed, 1337 passed, 158 subtests passed in 5.56s ``` ## Summary The math plugin's inline parser rule (`INLINE_MATH_PATTERN`) currently produces block-level `block_math` tokens when encountering double dollar signs (`$$...$$`) within inline text, causing paragraph splitting and HTML validation errors. By updating `parse_inline_math` in `src/mistune/plugins/math.py` to emit `inline_math` tokens instead of `block_math` tokens for inline double-dollar expressions, inline equations are correctly rendered as `\(...\)` inline spans. Block-level math (`$$...$$` on its own line) continues to be parsed by the block parser as `block_math`, preserving correct block behavior. ## Files and functions to change - `src/mistune/plugins/math.py`: `parse_inline_math` - `tests/fixtures/math.txt`: `math` ## Plan 1. Update `parse_inline_math` in `src/mistune/plugins/math.py` so that when `display_math_text` is matched, it appends an `inline_math` token instead of a `block_math` token (`{"type": "inline_math", "raw": display_text}`). (Satisfies AC-FR-001-1) 2. Add new test cases and update existing fixture cases in `tests/fixtures/math.txt` to verify that inline `$$...$$` expressions render as `\(...\)` within paragraphs without splitting paragraphs, while block-level `$$...$$` expressions continue to render as `
...
`. (Satisfies AC-FR-001-1, AC-FR-002-1, AC-NFR-001-1) 3. Run test suite (`uv run pytest`), linter (`uv run ruff check .`), and type checker (`uv run mypy`) to ensure all tests pass and typing/linting standards are strictly maintained. (Satisfies CON-001, NFR-001) ## Risks - **Risk 1:** Breaking existing users who relied on inline `$$...$$` producing block-level `
`. *Mitigation:* As noted in the issue and requirements (SRC-001, FR-001), rendering inline double-dollar math as block divs causes broken paragraph layouts and HTML validation errors. The requirement explicitly mandates rendering inline `$$...$$` as inline span elements. Block-level math on its own lines (`$$...$$` parsed by block parser) remains unaffected. - **Risk 2:** Type checking (`uv run mypy`) or linting (`uv run ruff check .`) failures. *Mitigation:* No new types or imports are introduced; token dictionaries follow the existing structure used by `inline_math`. Date:   Tue Nov 24 13:44:23 2026 +0530

    Design check: accept (new) inside backticks, do not check test-function names; stop messages carry the check reasons
    
    Run 45353435408 (issue #4): the design marked two planned test functions as
    `TestTocHook.test_render_ordered_toc (new)` (marker inside the backticks); the parser only
    accepted the marker after the closing backtick and stripped ')', so a correct design failed
    twice and the run stopped with 'check did not pass within its retries'.
    
    - (new) / [new] accepted inside or after the backticks, any case; trailing () ignored
    - files under tests/ are only checked for existence: test functions are written later by the
      test workers, so the design stage should not be judged on them
    - spec/design/implement failures record their reasons, and the stop message shows them
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
